scope: Select a single executable method for the already frozen confirmation groups, after the entire scout completes.
eligibility: Both datasets must have nondecreasing accuracy, macro F1, all three recalls, and each mechanism accuracy, with a strict accuracy increase on at least one dataset.
prefer: Eligible single-call methods over multi-call consensus; within equal call count, maximize the minimum of the two dataset accuracy gains, then the sum of accuracy gains, then minimize observed tokens, then alphabetical name.
if_none: Do not call the scout a success. Preserve all negative results and explore another general method on development data before independent confirmation.
freeze_confirmation: Freeze candidate and all prompt/config/source hashes before any confirmation calls. Use contemporaneous A27. No adaptation from partial confirmation scores.
confirmation_gate: The same dataset, class and mechanism nonregression gate, with cost and paired group-bootstrap uncertainty reported separately.
final_test: Not authorized for external transmission in this dialogue. Keep sealed; no test claims.
